signals.claim: The report distinguishes collaborative from delegated AI use and identifies access to relevant organizational context as a constraint on sophisticated enterprise deployment.
The January report describes collaborative use as more common than automated use in its November Claude.ai sample. This platform observation does not establish task replacement.

task_interpretations.interpretation: The newer collaboration finding adds context for considering human-reviewed cleaning workflows. Applying it to this task is our interpretation; cleaning automation is not measured.
The newer collaboration finding adds context for considering iterative report review. Applying it to this task is our interpretation; reporting automation is not measured.
